"""Browser fixtures for workspace tests.

Generated and hand-written UI tests receive a real Playwright page here, so a test never has to
fabricate the page it asserts on. Set ``AI_QA_BROWSER_CHANNEL`` (for example ``chrome``) when the
bundled headless shell is unavailable on the host. The browser is launched per test and always closed.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import os

import pytest
from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright


@pytest.fixture
def page():
    channel = os.environ.get("AI_QA_BROWSER_CHANNEL") or None
    with sync_playwright() as playwright:
        browser = playwright.chromium.launch(headless=True, channel=channel)
        context = browser.new_context()
        test_page = context.new_page()
        try:
            yield test_page
        finally:
            context.close()
            browser.close()

evidence: 错误为 playwright._impl._errors.TimeoutError: Locator.click: Timeout 1500ms exceeded.，Call log 显示 waiting for locator("#submit")。
当前页面证据显示 current_url 为 http://127.0.0.1:8099/、title 为 "Locator Fixture"，observed_controls 仅包含 "Save"。
controls 中该控件为 <button>、role=button、name="Save"、visible=true、enabled=true，候选定位含 role=button[name="Save"]、text="Save"、css="button"。
失败步骤 recent_steps 显示 action=click、locator=#submit、status=FAILED、耗时 1553.6ms，来源 tests/test_locator_repair.py:6。
failure evidence bundle 缺少 screenshot、trace、dom、recorder_element_evidence 四类证据。
hypotheses: 测试目标按钮已从 id="submit" 改为文本 "Save" 的 button，需要更新定位器。
页面可能未渲染出带 #submit 的元素，而是用其他属性或标签承载同一保存动作。
1500ms 超时相对偏短，但当前证据没有加载延迟迹象，且历史分类一致指向定位器变化。
recommended_actions: 用 role=button[name="Save"] 或 text="Save" 替换 page.locator("#submit")，仅修改定位方式，保留 expect(page.locator("#status")).to_have_text("Saved") 断言不变。
补充采集 dom、screenshot、trace，确认 "Save" 按钮是否即原 #submit 对应的保存动作。
确认 #status 元素在点击 "Save" 后仍存在且文本变为 "Saved"，避免连带失败。
